card.name: Symbols and digits attached to terms
card.fires_on: Small marker characters stuck directly onto a preceding term: superscript or footnote marks like †, a, 1, 2 after units or headings, and digits inside odd codes. Seen in tables, units such as km2, and math-like labels.

modes.label: Superscript after units
modes.description: A digit or zero after a unit or symbol letter, as in km2 or wavelength l0.

modes.label: Table footnote marks
modes.description: A dagger, letter or number marking a footnote after a table heading or term.
modes.example: Infection<<†>> Unit Dose Frequency Duration Daily Dose

modes.label: Digit inside a code name
modes.description: A digit within a trial or experiment name.

card.plain: It fires on tiny footnote marks and exponent digits glued onto the end of a term.
